Recommended rungs from 0.99 J to 517 kJ step by at most 16.4x (apple to air rifle; then 10.0x, 10.5x, 4.3x, 9.3x, 7.6x, and 2.0x up to the existing grenade at about 1.0 MJ), so under ladder.js nearest-rung matching no energy from 0.86 J to the grenade needs a multiple above about 4x or a share below about 25%.
